project.name: Argo Orchestrator
project.description: Workflow orchestration service for internal jobs.

issues.summary: Use Auth API v1 for workflow service tokens
issues.content:
Issue: ARGO-201
Summary: Use Auth API v1 for workflow service tokens
Type: Story
Status: Done
Assignee: Ravi Kulkarni
Reporter: Tara Bose
Labels: authentication, workflow, production

Description:
Argo Orchestrator consumes Auth API v1. Before starting a workflow, Argo requests a service token from POST /v1/auth. Workflow execution cannot begin when this dependency is unavailable.

issues.content:
Issue: ARGO-202
Summary: Document authentication failure behavior
Type: Task
Status: Done
Assignee: Ravi Kulkarni
Reporter: Tara Bose
Labels: runbook, authentication

Description:
If Auth API v1 rejects a service credential, Argo marks the workflow as blocked and does not execute any tasks. The runbook must link the failed request to POST /v1/auth.
